description: Fetch G2 B2B SaaS customer reviews for a product slug, software name, or G2 URL (automatically resolves canonical G2 slug first to avoid missing-slug errors), including title, pros, cons, nps_score, submitted_at, helpful count, 5-star histogram, and aspect sentiment polarities. Cost: 2 Credits / review returned (0 Credits on empty/error).

limit.description: Maximum G2 customer reviews to return (1-50).

product.description: G2 product slug (e.g. "slack", "notion"), software name, or g2.com/products/... URL.

name: g2_reviews

data.description: Normalized reviews payload containing target metadata, sentiment_summary (star_distribution and polarity_breakdown), and paginated reviews array.

meta.description: Gateway billing and cache telemetry (credits_charged, credits_remaining, cache hit/miss, latency_ms).

title: Extract G2 SaaS Customer Reviews, Pros/Cons, NPS Score & Sentiment Polarity
